interface.longDescription:
Website Design helps you design and redesign websites by chat, from style and layout to design-ready code and reviews, and when you want your site built, it prepares a personalized build link after 5 quick questions.

What you can do:
- Find your style: 2 to 3 design directions with mood, color palettes with hex codes and checked contrast, and font pairings.
- Lay out every page: section-by-section wireframes for home, about, services, pricing, contact, blog and landing pages.
- Design key pages: homepages, landing pages and portfolio sites, with the copy that goes in the design.
- Review a design: paste a page's HTML or text to get scores for content, conversion, accessibility, mobile and SEO basics, with a prioritized list of fixes.
- Redesign an existing page: what to keep, what to change and a before and after of the hero section.
- Design for everyone and every screen: accessibility fixes based on WCAG and mobile-first responsive layouts.
- Build a small design system: color and type tokens, spacing and components as CSS variables.
- See it as code: design-ready single-file HTML and CSS pages.
- Get a build link: answer 5 quick questions and get a personalized link that opens an online website builder with your design brief already filled in.

Who it is for: business owners, designers, freelancers, creators and marketers who want a website that looks great and works.

How the tools work: the page checker analyzes only the HTML or text you share in the conversation. It never opens web addresses, and the pages and briefs you send are not stored. The build link opens an online website builder with your brief and includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. Website Design is an independent plugin by AI Research Plus.

Limitations: Website Design writes design directions, layouts, copy and code in the conversation. It does not host or publish websites, create image files or connect to your website's dashboard. Details it cannot know about your business are marked for you to confirm or fill in.

The reply with the build link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.

defaultPrompt: Pick colors and fonts for my site

positive.description: Design review of a hero section
positive.prompt:
Review the design of this hero section:

Hi

We make things.

Click here
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML and page type home, reports the scores and flags the image with no alt text, the missing title and viewport tag, the thin copy and the vague "Click here" button, then suggests design and copy fixes in severity order, including a stronger headline and call to action.

positive.prompt: Check this page for accessibility:
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports the scores and flags the image with no alt attribute, the form field with no label, the anchor with no text a screen reader can announce and the missing language attribute, title, H1 heading and viewport tag, then suggests accessible fixes in severity order.

positive.prompt:
Is this page mobile friendly? Bloom Studio

Bloom Studio
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports that there is no viewport meta tag, so phones will show a zoomed-out desktop layout, plus the missing meta description and language attribute, then gives the viewport tag to add and mobile layout fixes.

positive.prompt: Review my homepage copy for clarity: Grow faster. Our solution leverages synergy. Submit
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the text and page type home, reports that the copy is thin for a home page, has no clear call to action or trust signals and uses a vague "Submit" button, then suggests a clearer headline, subheadline and call to action.

positive.prompt:
Check the headings on this page:

Our work

About

Text
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports that the page has no H1 heading and no title tag, notes the two H2 headings and the missing meta description and viewport tag, then suggests a heading structure with one H1 and fixes in severity order.

negative.prompt: Suggest a calm color palette for a yoga studio site.
